rows.title: Node RPC location
rows.notes: Operator topology. CI must not connect. Credentials never in git.

rows.title: RPC transport
rows.value: JSON-RPC POST-only; HTTP 307 to HTTPS; TLS 1.3; Basic realm=jsonrpc; 401 without credentials
rows.notes: GET body: JSONRPC server handles only POST requests. Cert CN=localhost O=Start9 OU=StartOS.

rows.title: Network / fork identifier
rows.notes: Template network bitcoin-blake2b is an authoring placeholder, not a probed chain name.

rows.title: Transaction format
rows.notes: Do not assume Bitcoin Core serialization.

rows.title: Address and key formats
rows.notes: Spec treats addresses and pubkeys as opaque strings.

rows.title: Script capabilities
rows.notes: Do not assume Bitcoin Core script or Taproot.

rows.title: Signature hashing
rows.notes: Do not assume Core sighash types.

rows.title: Partial-signing / PSBT-like
rows.notes: Do not assume Bitcoin Core PSBT.

rows.title: Reorg behavior
rows.notes: Architecture: block anchors are chain context, not wall-clock.

rows.title: Test / regtest environment
rows.notes: No existing CI/regtest fixture. Offline fixtures only.

rows.title: BITSCROW contract-state digest
rows.notes: Unkeyed BLAKE2b, 32-byte digest. Not blake2s, not blake2b-512, not a keyed MAC.

rows.title: Fork txid / block hash algorithm
rows.notes: May also be blake2b; params unconfirmed. Do not equate with bitscrow-digest until cited.
